Initial release of Data Visualizer — SVG Chart Generator:

- Generate bar charts, line charts, pie charts, scatter plots, heatmaps, dashboards, comparisons, and trend analysis as pure SVG.
- Simple command-based interface for different chart types.
- Accepts comma-separated label:value pairs as input.
- Produces complete SVG code usable in browsers, HTML, Markdown, or email.
- Features automatic color palettes, responsive sizing, multi-language support, and zero external dependencies.
